column20: MODEL YEAR IS RECORDED AS NINE NINE NINE NINE AND THE ODOMETER READING WAS LOGGED AS ZERO.
MODEL YEAR AND MILEAGE ARE BOTH ABSENT WHILE EVERY YES NO FLAG ON THE ROW IS SET TO YES.
MODEL YEAR IS NON NUMERIC AND MILEAGE IS THE SEVEN DIGIT SENTINEL WHILE EVERY YES NO FLAG IS EMPTY.
MODEL YEAR CONTAINS A LETTER AND THE MILEAGE COLUMN CONTAINS LETTERS INSTEAD OF DIGITS.
EVERY DATE COLUMN EXCEPT THE RECEIVED DATE IS EMPTY ON THIS ROW.
THE INCIDENT DATE HAS AN IMPOSSIBLE MONTH AND DAY AND THE DATE ADDED USES DASHES INSTEAD OF PLAIN DIGITS.
A TREAD SEPARATION OCCURRED ON THE DRIVER SIDE FRONT TYRE AT HIGHWAY SPEED.
THE CHILD RESTRAINT BUCKLE RELEASES WHEN THE HARNESS IS PULLED FORWARD BY A TODDLER.
THE TRAILER COUPLER RELEASED FROM THE HITCH BALL WHILE UNDER LOAD ON A GRADE.
THE PRODUCT TYPE COLUMN IS EMPTY ON THIS ROW SO THE INGEST FILTER MUST NOT ASSUME A VALUE.
THE MAKE IS SPELLED AS TWO WORDS WITHOUT A HYPHEN ON THIS ROW.
THE MAKE IS SPELLED WITH A HYPHEN ON THIS ROW AND MUST CANONICALIZE TO THE SAME BRAND AS THE PREVIOUS ROW.
THE MAKE IS RECORDED AS THE TWO LETTER ABBREVIATION.
THE MAKE IS RECORDED USING THE COLLOQUIAL SHORT FORM.
THE MAKE COLUMN CARRIES A FULL LEGAL ENTITY NAME INCLUDING A COMMA AND A SUFFIX.
THE MAKE COLUMN HAS LEADING AND TRAILING SPACES AND COLLAPSED WHITESPACE IN LOWER CASE.

THE TECHNICIAN LOGGED THREE CODES:  P0301  P0302  P0303  AND NOTED THAT THE MISFIRE COUNTER RESET AFTER EVERY RESTART.  THE TAB CHARACTERS THAT SEPARATED THOSE CODES ON THE PRINTOUT ARE REPRESENTED HERE AS RUNS OF SPACES.
A CRASH AND A FIRE ARE BOTH FLAGGED ON THIS ROW WITH FOUR INJURED AND TWO FATALITIES RECORDED.
THE COMPONENT DESCRIPTION COLUMN IS EMPTY SO THE TAXONOMY MAPPER MUST FALL BACK TO AN UNKNOWN CATEGORY.
MILEAGE CARRIES LEADING ZEROES AND THE OCCURRENCE COUNT IS EMPTY.
VEHICLE SPEED AND CYLINDER COUNT ARE EMPTY AND EVERY TRAILING COLUMN AFTER THE PRODUCT TYPE IS BLANK.
